summary: Basal 29 cm of FC(DH) 3 mm (4F-/4F gradient, flagged 'problematic layer') under a 1F FCxr layer 29-40 cm, 4F DF 40-50 cm and soft F DF 50-65 cm at the surface; CT13 SC (x2) at 15 cm in the basal FC/DH; S aspect 15 deg at 2280 m; HS 65 cm; PF 60, PS 30; no temperature profile
reading_issues: Hardness bars and layer boundaries measured from pixels against the chart axes (boundaries 50, 40, 29 cm fall on whole cm). The basal 0-29 cm layer is a trapezoid (4F- at base, 4F at top); hardness_idx is the mean (1.83) and the label '4F' is the nearer-upper label at an exact tie between 4F- and 4F. The small glyph in the 29-40 cm layer (square with a rounded dome and a horizontal line) is read as FCxr; no size entered for that layer. Slash glyphs at 40-65 cm read as DF. The 'x2' after the CT result is non-bold free text; recorded as count 2. Surface-form row above the HS line is blank, so surface_grain is null. Elevation, coordinates, aspect and slope are as printed in the header.
